summary: Machine inputs for cycle 20260913T1300Z are healthy and its persisted machine head 891117f5d80add03f6cf3d51b19ff5c8ec7333dc has successful explicit CI, but supervisor report persistence necessarily creates later branch commits. A strict interpretation that requires workflow_dispatch CI on the branch head after every supervisor-only report commit would create a coordination deadlock unless Chief can dispatch post-council CI. Treat machine-cycle CI identity and immutable specialist artifact blob identity as separate integrity proofs until that policy is made explicit.

materialFindings.finding: Machine cycle 20260913T1300Z persisted on head 891117f5d80add03f6cf3d51b19ff5c8ec7333dc and explicit Earth 2036 CI workflow_dispatch run 34760004102 completed successfully on that exact SHA.

Council Alpha writes immutable lane reports after the machine CI pass; those report-only commits advance the PR ref even though the reviewed machine cycle and code/data state remain bound to the earlier machine SHA.
materialFindings.decisionRelevance: If exact-head CI is interpreted as requiring a new workflow_dispatch after every report-only commit, Chief cannot safely satisfy the gate without an explicit post-council dispatch mechanism. Artifact blob verification already separately protects lane content.

contradictions.detail: The intended exact-head CI contract protects machine persistence, but specialist reports are intentionally persisted after that CI. The policy needs an explicit distinction between machine-cycle head verification and report blob verification, or a post-council CI dispatch step.

unknowns.detail: Google Sheet parity remains for Chief to verify in this cycle.
Row-level FINRA event data remains unavailable without authenticated Query API capability.

peerRequests.request: Resolve the exact-head policy without weakening integrity: preferred interpretation is successful explicit CI bound to the reviewed machine-cycle SHA plus exact immutable Git blob SHA validation for each post-machine lane report. If policy instead requires CI after council persistence, add/execute a post-council workflow_dispatch before approval.
Verify the Google Sheet mirror and required manual FINRA/OTC event interpretation before approval.

accuracyDebates.accuracyGain: Post-council exact-head CI would prove the entire branch including report artifacts passes CI.
accuracyDebates.cost: It adds another dispatch per hour and can create timing/deadlock issues because report persistence itself changes the ref; report JSON is already content-addressed by Git blob SHA and deterministic finalizer validation.
accuracyDebates.recommendation: Bind CI to the machine-cycle SHA and bind specialist intelligence to exact report blob SHAs unless code or canonical machine state changes after CI. Require new CI only when executable/canonical state changes, not for append-only supervisor reports.

blockingIssues.detail: Sheet parity and FINRA-required manual/event interpretation are incomplete in this lane.
Chief must explicitly resolve the machine-head-versus-report-head CI interpretation before claiming persistence/CI integrity is fully healthy.
